purpose: pf_number must be unique: creating a second profile with the same pf_number is rejected
preconditions: An EmployeeProfile with pf_number='PF001' already exists
action_or_input: Create another EmployeeProfile with pf_number='PF001' for a different user
expected_result: IntegrityError is raised; second profile is not persisted

purpose: Profile with a unique pf_number is accepted
expected_result: Profile is created successfully without error

purpose: Work experience end_date earlier than start_date is rejected
preconditions: Employee profile exists; user is authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 400 with error message on end_date: 'End date cannot be earlier than start date.'

purpose: Work experience end_date equal to start_date is accepted
preconditions: Employee profile exists; user is authenticated

purpose: Work experience with null end_date (ongoing role) is allowed
preconditions: Employee profile exists; user is authenticated

purpose: Non-staff employee can only view their own profile (data isolation)
preconditions: Two EmployeeProfiles exist for two different non-staff users
action_or_input: GET /api/v1/hr-eis/profiles/ authenticated as one of the non-staff employees
expected_result: HTTP 200 returning only the authenticated employee's own profile; no other profile included

purpose: Staff user can view all employee profiles
preconditions: Multiple EmployeeProfiles exist; staff user is authenticated

purpose: Work experiences are scoped to the authenticated employee only
preconditions: Two employees each have different WorkExperience entries
expected_result: HTTP 200 returning only employee A's work experiences; employee B's not visible

purpose: Authentication is required for all API endpoints
Work experience automatically linked to authenticated employee's profile on create
preconditions: Employee profile exists; user is authenticated
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hr-eis/experiences/ with valid data (no employee field in payload)
expected_result: HTTP 201; experience is linked to the authenticated user's EmployeeProfile in the database

purpose: designation must be one of the allowed choices

expected_result: Validation error raised; profile not persisted

purpose: department must be one of the allowed choices
action_or_input: Create an EmployeeProfile with department='PHYSICS' (not in allowed choices)
expected_result: Validation error raised; profile not persisted
